_README: Destination-specific facts used by xrefs.py when it resolves a cross-reference. Every entry is
VERIFIED against the product code at the revision named below and cites file and lines, or it is
not in this file at all. Nothing here is inferred from the manuals.
A destination absent from this file gets NO generated field list or screen claim — the adaptation
says only what the manual's own section heading establishes, and marks the rest unresolved. That is
deliberate: the Crewing screens (Appraisals, Crew Promotion, the Annual/Periodic/Monthly/Other/
Summary drug & alcohol tests, and the Recruited/Waitlist/Rejected crew lists) are not in any
repository available here, so their field lists cannot be verified and must not be invented.
Keys are matched case-insensitively against the destination sub-module name that xrefs.py derives
